title.zh: 规定治安法官审理的任何刑事案件中，若案件被驳回或被告人被宣告无罪，则不得向有关市镇征收公务费用的法案
title.en: An Act Providing that in Any Criminal Proceeding Before a Justice of the Peace No Cost De Oficio Shall be Taxed Against the Municipality Concerned When the Case is Dismissed or the Defendant Acquitted
title.orig: An Act Providing that in Any Criminal Proceeding Before a Justice of the Peace No Cost De Oficio Shall be Taxed Against the Municipality Concerned When the Case is Dismissed or the Defendant Acquitted
title.vi: Đạo luật quy định rằng trong mọi vụ án hình sự trước Thẩm phán Hòa giải, không được tính phí tố tụng theo chức vụ đối với thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh liên quan khi vụ án bị bác bỏ hoặc bị cáo được tuyên trắng án
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดว่าในการดำเนินคดีอาญาใดๆต่อหน้าผู้พิพากษาสันติสุขไม่ให้มีการเรียกเก็บค่าใช้จ่ายตามตำแหน่งงานจากราชการต่อเทศบาลที่เกี่ยวข้องเมื่อคดีถูกยกเลิกหรือจำเลยได้รับการปล่อยตัวโดยไม่มีความผิด
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan bahwa dalam setiap proses pidana di hadapan Hakim Perdamaian, tidak boleh dikenakan biaya resmi terhadap kotamadya terkait apabila perkara dicabut atau terdakwa dibebaskan
title.ms: Akta menetapkan bahawa dalam mana-mana prosiding jenayah di hadapan Hakim Damai, tiada kos rasmi akan dikenakan terhadap perbandaran yang berkaitan apabila kes dibuang atau tertuduh dibebaskan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1946/ra_15_1946.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provisions of law to the contrary notwithstanding, in any criminal proceeding before a justice of the peace no cost de oficio shall be taxed against the municipality concerned when the case is dismissed or the defendant acquitted.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: September 18, 1946
